title: $D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X,E)$
statement:
For a prime $\ell$, a scheme $X$ and a finite extension $E$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside $\Qlb$,
let $\underline E$ be the condensed ring of the topological field $E$ with the topology
restricted from $\Qlb$ ([def-sfb-padic-subfield-condensed-ring]), and put
$E_X=p_X^*\underline E$ ([sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]).
Then $D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X,E)$ is the bounded constructible derived category
([sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible]) of modules over $E_X$
([sk-def-sfb-module-objects]): the full subcategory of $D(\Mod_{E_X})$ of complexes that
are bounded and have constructible cohomology sheaves. Its morphisms are those in
$D(\Mod_{E_X})$.
